name: Point Gaussian Representation
definition: Drawing a 2D image sprite that may have transparency at points, instead of 3D geometry. Predefined sprites include Gaussian Blur, Sphere, Black-edged circle, Plain circle, Triangle, Square outline, or custom GLSL shader code.
summary: Point Gaussian Representation renders datasets as 2D transparent sprites at each point, offering a lightweight, efficient alternative to 3D geometry for visualizing large point clouds.
